ModMetaData.name: Follow Me Smoothly!
ModMetaData.author: Fluffy
ModMetaData.description: Gives the camera tracking capabilities, this version allows for smooth camera movement. Features - Press 'Home' (default keybinding) to toggle following the selected target. - Press 'End' (default keybinding) to toggle cinematic camera mode, which will automatically switch between colonists. - Configurable camera smoothness (via mod settings, 1 is extreme smoothing, 0 is no smoothing). Press the 'Home' key (default, can be changed with in-game keybinding settings) while any colonist, enemy, animal or item is selected, and the camera will follow them (including furniture and plants - but they tend to not move much). Alternatively, you can click with the middle mouse button on colonists in the Colonist Bar on top of the screen to toggle following. Does not require a new save game Can safely be enabled/disabled in ongoing saves.
